card.name: Linking words after abstract nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right after an abstract noun, such as 'between' after 'link' or 'feedback', that introduce what the noun relates to or explains.

modes.label: between after link/feedback
modes.description: The word 'between' follows a relational noun like link or feedback.

modes.label: Punctuation or which after noun
modes.description: A comma, colon or 'which' follows a noun phrase and opens an elaboration.
